$type.description: The polymorphic admin menu node type discriminator, for example OrchardCore.AdminMenu.AdminNodes.LinkAdminNode, OrchardCore.AdminMenu. Required so the node deserializes correctly.

UniqueId.description: A stable unique identifier for the node. When omitted, one is generated when the recipe runs.

Enabled.description: Whether the node is active. Defaults to true.

MenuName.description: The name of the admin menu the node belongs to. Populated automatically when the recipe runs.

Position.description: The relative position of the node among its siblings, for example '10' or 'after'.

Priority.description: The priority used to resolve which node is marked as selected when several match the request.

LinkToFirstChild.description: Whether the node links to the same URL as its first child.

LocalNav.description: Whether the node is local to the page, such as a tab.

Culture.description: The culture for which the node is shown. Leave null to show it for every culture.

Classes.description: The CSS classes rendered with the node.

ContentTypeName.description: The technical name of the content type to add.

ContentTypeDisplayName.description: The display name of the content type shown in the menu.

ContentTypes.description: The explicit list of content types to add when ShowAll is false.
